style52: Art direction: stylized hand-painted 3D game art for an Eastern xianxia fantasy world (Chinese immortal-cultivation setting), warm golden morning light from a low sun, soft warm rim light on edges and silhouettes, gentle blue-violet shadows (never pure black), layered soft white mist in the distance, painterly textures made of large soft colour gradients with a few visible brush strokes, rich but natural colour palette (sunlit warm yellow-greens, cool teal shade greens, warm grey stone, aged brown timber, blue-grey roof tiles, turquoise water), lived-in details: wear on edges, moss and soil in the joints, patched and repaired parts, small cracks, weathered wood grain, high level of detail with clear readable shapes and a strong silhouette, real-world scale and proportions, cohesive with a hand-painted xianxia valley village, game-ready asset look, high quality, masterpiece.
